notes.title: Rifle Range High Score Challenge
notes.content:
To celebrate the launch of the new in-game rifle range, we're hosting a competition to see who can get the highest scores. All you need to do to participate is make sure you update to the latest version of the game, enter "The Range" from the menu, and start shooting! The top 3 scores at the end of the week (12/20 11:59PM EST) will receive the following prizes:

[list]
[b][*]First Prize: $60 SteamVR Game of Your Choice
[*]Second Prize: $20 SteamVR Game of Your Choice
[*]Third Prize: $10 SteamVR Game of Your Choice[/b]
[/list]
Additional Rules:
Scores must be a minimum of 39 or higher. In the event of a tie, the first player to record the score wins. You must have a valid e-mail address associated with your account in order to be eligible. All prices are in U.S. Dollars.
